svg.title: QuanFangwei user-authored Hiragana SVG master
svg.desc: 43 basic Hiragana vectorized from the project maintainer's own handwriting. わ, を, and ん are absent from the source chart.
svg.text: 43 source glyphs · normalized 960 × 1024 y-up paths · Version 1.010
Source chart omits わ・を・ん; those glyphs retain the existing project-local designs.
